```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN num.Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(den.Id), 0) AS accepted_rate
FROM (
  SELECT Id, AcceptedAnswerId
  FROM main.posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 1
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', CreaionDate) = '2010-12-01'
) den
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT Id
  FROM main.posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 2
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', CreaionDate) = '2010-12-01'
) num ON den.AcceptedAnswerId = num.Id
```
